name: How do payment-provider callbacks and webhooks update payment status?
description:
Paystack, Monnify, and PaymentPoint send callback or webhook requests containing a transaction reference and provider status. EduManager uses the reference to locate the payment record and process or verify the transaction; reserved-account deposits follow their configured account and transaction checks.

Integration operators should register the application's configured callback/webhook URLs with the provider and keep the matching credentials and signature settings current. Reconcile a transaction in Payment Attempts by its reference; do not treat a browser redirect alone as proof of payment.
